name: memory_rehearse
description: Rehearse a memory by ID to strengthen it without changing its valence. This updates storage strength S (via ΔS = s_gain(1-D)) and retrieval strength D, making the memory more resistant to decay and easier to recall. Use this when a memory is still relevant but no positive/negative outcome feedback is available. Unlike reinforce, rehearsal does not shift the emotional valence.

memory_id.description: The ID of the memory to rehearse.

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.
